tips.open: Shows the saved strategies to open.
tips.save: Saves the strategy and checks it. Saving always works, even with findings.
tips.check: Looks for problems such as missing connections or empty required entries.
tips.close: Closes the strategy. With unsaved changes Studio asks first.
tips.delete: Deletes the open strategy after confirmation.
tips.settings: Language and storage location of the objects.

library.hint: A click inserts an element after the selected step. You can also drag it onto the canvas.

connection.name: Connection

canvas.portManagement: The order and position management of this order starts here. If it has no trigger of its own, drag from here to its first step.
canvas.portReconnect: Drag to another step to connect differently
canvas.portConnect: Drag to the next step, or click and then click the next step
canvas.portValue: Drag from here to an element to connect this value
canvas.refuses: Not usable here: the value is first worked out at another element.
canvas.orientVerticalTip: Flow vertical: entry on top, exits below
canvas.orientHorizontalTip: Flow horizontal from left to right, for wide screens

wiresTip.all: Show the dashed lines of all further uses
wiresTip.selection: Show only the dashed lines of the selected element or object
wiresTip.off: Show no dashed lines. The line to the element of the first use stays.

canvas.legendMoreUses: Value at a further use (coloured, dashed)

used.title: Values in use
used.info: These are the values of objects that this element uses. You choose which property or method is meant. Where a formula of the element names the value, the formula changes with it.
used.empty: This element does not use any value of an object yet. Connect a value below, or name it in a formula.
used.refreshTip: The object works out its values again at this element before it passes them on. You need this when the values may be out of date by now, for example in an order and position management that runs on new prices.
used.inAssignment: as the value of a field
used.addHint: Connect a further value without dragging:
used.noneUsable: No object that is not connected yet can be used at this element. An object that is worked out somewhere else is not on offer here. Add another object with its own name for this.

firstUse.title: Element of the first use
firstUse.info: The object works out its values at the element that uses it first. Before that element it is not available. Other elements can use it only if every way to them leads through this element.
firstUse.none: No element uses this object yet.
firstUse.at: The object is worked out at "{{element}}".

properties.applicationObjectsHint: These objects always exist. Formulas can use their values.
properties.notChecked: Not checked yet. "Check" looks for problems such as missing connections or empty required entries.
properties.noFindings: No findings. The strategy is consistent.
properties.findingsGeneral: These findings belong to no single element.

properties.sectionHint: On the canvas the section collapses and expands with the button at its title.
properties.name: Name
properties.unknownType: The type "{{type}}" is unknown. Its entries are only shown and stay unchanged when saving.

properties.belongsToHint: Here you decide whether the step belongs to the main flow or to the order and position management of an order, without dragging it.

issues.syntax: Correct the spelling at the named position.
issues.unknown_name: Choose a value that exists: an object on the canvas, a strategy parameter or the result of a step.
issues.unknown_property: Choose a property that the object supplies.
issues.type_mismatch: Use a value of the fitting kind.
issues.unknown_choice_value: Choose one of the allowed values.
issues.argument_count: Give the fitting number of entries.

trigger.unconnected: Connect the trigger with the first step or remove it.
trigger.manual_in_management: Remove the trigger from the order and position management and add another trigger there, or put it into the main flow.

flow.not_reached: Connect a previous step or a trigger with this step or remove it.
flow.main_without_trigger: Add a trigger to the main flow and connect it with the first step.
flow.unending_loop: Put a condition into the loop from which one output leads out of the loop.
flow.management_only: Move the step into the order and position management of an order or remove it.
flow.no_order_reachable: Connect the flow with a step that places an order.

instrument.invalid: Correct the designation of the instrument.

data.unknown: Choose an object and a property that exist, or delete the connection.
data.type_mismatch: Connect a value of the fitting kind.

input.unused: Use the value in a formula or remove the connection.
input.refresh_not_allowed: Switch "Refresh" off for this value. If you need current values, add another object with a name of its own and use that one.

instance.not_usable: Add another object with a name of its own and use that one at this element, or use the object only at elements that lie behind the element where it is first used.
instance.unconnected: Connect the object with the element that needs its values first, or remove it.

layout.invalid: Remove the section and create it again.

expression.order_outside_management: Use order and position only in the order and position management of an order.

rule.unresolved_name: Check the name in the formula of the template.
rule.result_mismatch: Change the formula of the rule or choose another determined property.
rule.order_in_indicator: Remove the rule from the indicator or trend and assign it to the strategy or to an element.
rule.invalid_type: Remove the object from this list.

parameter.missing: Give the field a value: enter it, choose a strategy parameter, or set it when the strategy starts.
parameter.binding_invalid: Under "Where does the value come from?", choose a fitting option.

order.property_missing: Give the property a value or assign a rule that determines it to the element or the strategy.

ruleset.reference_order: Change the order of the rules so that each rule only uses earlier results.

candle.no_instance: Put a candle with a time unit on the canvas and use its values.

name.duplicate: Give one of the two another name.

type.unknown: Remove the element or install the extension that supplies the type.

trend.direction_missing: Enter the formula for the direction of the trend.

calculation.circular_reference: Change one of the calculations so that it does not lead back to itself.

findings.truncated: Fix the findings shown and check again.

connection.invalid: Delete the connection and draw it again.

element.rules_not_allowed: Remove the rules from this element.
element.management_invalid: Move the element into the main flow or into the order and position management of an order.
